description: This file is a header for the xxHash library, defining functions, types, and macros for fast hash computation, including 32-bit and 64-bit variants, with support for inlining and namespace customization.

methods.name: XXH32
methods.description: Calculates the 32-bit hash of a memory block with a seed.

methods.name: XXH64
methods.description: Calculates the 64-bit hash of a memory block with a seed.

methods.name: XXH32_createState
methods.description: Creates a new state object for incremental 32-bit hashing.

methods.name: XXH64_createState
methods.description: Creates a new state object for incremental 64-bit hashing.

methods.name: XXH32_reset
methods.description: Initializes or resets the 32-bit hash state with a seed.

methods.name: XXH64_reset
methods.description: Initializes or resets the 64-bit hash state with a seed.

methods.name: XXH32_update
methods.description: Updates the 32-bit hash state with additional input data.

methods.name: XXH64_update
methods.description: Updates the 64-bit hash state with additional input data.

methods.name: XXH32_digest
methods.description: Finalizes and returns the 32-bit hash value.

methods.name: XXH64_digest
methods.description: Finalizes and returns the 64-bit hash value.

methods.name: XXH32_canonicalFromHash
methods.description: Converts a hash value to its canonical big-endian form.

methods.name: XXH64_canonicalFromHash
methods.description: Converts a hash value to its canonical big-endian form.

methods.name: XXH32_hashFromCanonical
methods.description: Converts a canonical hash back to its numeric form.

methods.name: XXH64_hashFromCanonical
methods.description: Converts a canonical hash back to its numeric form.

methods.name: XXH_versionNumber
methods.description: Returns the version number of the xxHash library.
